So, you've played a lot of Stardew Valley, and have been looking for mods to add more to the game. And you hit the jackpot - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=description]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]! The problem? You're a furry, and the new characters don't quite fit in...

Well, worry no more! With this mod, Stardew Valley Expanded is right at your paw-tips!

[b]INSTALLATION[/b]

[i]In order to use this mod, you will need to first install:[/i]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083?tab=files]Anthro Characters Continued[/url]﻿ and required dependencies
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=description]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ and required dependencies
[/list]
[i]Windows/Linux Users:
[/i]Once those are installed, you will need to download the appropriate files and drag it into the mod folder, and agree to the overwrites. This mod will overwrite sprites for Stardew Valley NPCs (Mostly SVE characters, and some background characters from vanilla).

[i]MAC:[/i]
Once those are installed, you will need to download the appropriate files and go through them and replace their counterparts file by file; apparently MAC doesn't allow easy merging of folders, so this is the suggested method. This mod will overwrite sprites for Stardew Valley NPCs (Mostly SVE characters, and some background characters from vanilla).

That's it. As such, this mod [i]should[/i] be usable with foreign language versions. Give it a go! If there's any visual bugs, please let me know!

I've also made some versions of Sebastian, if you're curious - one where [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2344]he has quit smoking[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2345/]gained weight[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2344]or both[/url]. Same with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5101]Alex[/url]. Enjoy!
